section_summary.extract_value: This section discusses the limitations and potential research extensions of the study. It highlights the need for further elaboration on theoretical processes related to mastery goals and self-regulation, the use of general cognitive ability instead of GPA, and the investigation of alternative goal orientation interventions. The section also suggests future research should explore the effects of distinct performance orientations (prove vs. avoid) and improve the assessment of knowledge structure. Finally, it notes that the study primarily used college students with a modest sample size, recommending larger and more varied samples for future replications.
